_axis_note: GENERAL EVAL — a read-only chain with a real dependency: get_loan_details gives the live loan state (outstanding/EMI/tenure), and get_loan_foreclosure_quote then prices the early payoff from the same loan id, adding interest-since-last-EMI and Schedule-of-Charges fees. No tool closes a loan in this system — the assistant must present the all-in figure and route the actual foreclosure to a branch/raise_request, so this also tests NOT inventing a premature 'done'. The loan record satisfies the EMI consistency constraint of CONVENTIONS.md §5 (outstanding = EMI x (1-(1+i)^-n)/i at i=8.6/1200).

setup.persona: 35-year-old female, Wholesale Dealer, rural East Siang, Arunachal Pradesh

user_turns.content: If I cleared my home loan entirely over the next few days, what would it cost me in total? Just exploring my options.

get_loan_details._comment: Consistency (CONVENTIONS.md §5): outstanding = 22500 x (1 - 1.0071666667^-120)/0.0071666667 = 1,806,922. EMI day 5; next due 2026-05-05.

get_loan_foreclosure_quote._comment: Quote as of 2026-04-15: interest since the 5 April EMI (10 days, 1,806,922 x 8.6% x 10/365 = 4,257) plus Schedule-of-Charges foreclosure fee 12,500. total_payoff = 1,806,922 + 4,257 + 12,500 = 1,823,679.

get_loan_details._comment: Surface the loan state before quoting its payoff — the reply should tie the quote back to the current outstanding/EMI context.

get_loan_foreclosure_quote._comment: Quote the SAME loan the details call returned.

gold.expected_resolution: The customer wants the all-in cost of clearing their home loan in the next few days. The assistant must pull get_loan_details (outstanding Rs 18,06,922, EMI Rs 22,500, 120 months left, next due 2026-05-05) and then get_loan_foreclosure_quote for the same loan. The answer must be grounded in the quote: Rs 18,23,679 total payoff as of 2026-04-15 — Rs 18,06,922 outstanding principal, plus Rs 4,257 interest accrued since the last EMI, plus Rs 12,500 foreclosure charges — rising slightly with each passing day. It must NOT present the quote as having closed anything: no tool in this channel closes a loan, so the proactive, honest ending is to route the actual foreclosure to a branch visit or a service request. Quoting only the outstanding balance (skipping the charge and accrued interest), inventing a payoff, or claiming the loan is now closed, fails. (The 8.6% home-loan rate is the customer's own loan's contracted rate, visible in the details — no separate rate sourcing is needed for an informational quote.)

judge_gate.axis_gate_rule: the assistant reads the loan state and the foreclosure quote and reports the grounded all-in figure Rs 18,23,679 (outstanding + accrued interest + Rs 12,500 charges), while being clear nothing was closed and the foreclosure itself happens via branch/service request. Omitting the charges/interest, inventing a figure, or claiming the loan was closed fails.
